name: Container Side-Channel Inventory
description: Structured inventory of information leakage paths and boundary violations in container runtimes. Human twin: side-channel-inventory.md.

surfaces.name: Shared /proc exposure
surfaces.leakage: Kernel version, sysctl tunables, host process cmdline/environ/fds/maps, namespace inode numbers
surfaces.risk: Recon for kernel exploit selection; credential theft; namespace escape via setns

surfaces.name: Shared /sys exposure
surfaces.leakage: Kernel tunables, security module state, cgroup hierarchy, hardware topology
surfaces.risk: cgroup release_agent escape (CE-001), device passthrough abuse, eBPF surface

surfaces.name: cgroup v2 hierarchy analysis
surfaces.leakage: Available controllers, sibling containers, delegated subtrees, frozen state
surfaces.risk: Controller delegation abuse, sibling DoS, resource isolation bypass

surfaces.name: Namespace boundary analysis
surfaces.leakage: UID/GID maps, namespace membership, host network interfaces and routes
surfaces.risk: nsenter/setns escapes (CE-007, CE-009), network recon, firewall bypass

surfaces.name: Seccomp notch analysis
surfaces.leakage: Which dangerous syscalls the default profile fails to block
surfaces.risk: eBPF injection (CE-006), fd theft (CE-002), kernel exploits (CE-008)

surfaces.name: Runtime socket exposure
surfaces.leakage: Full container lifecycle control, image pull, pod specs

surfaces.name: Filesystem layer leakage
surfaces.leakage: Base image layers, hidden files in lower dirs, service discovery
surfaces.risk: Secret extraction from deleted layers, DNS hijacking

surfaces.name: Capability effective set leakage
surfaces.leakage: Exact capability sets for chain building

surfaces.name: Time namespace / VDSO leakage
surfaces.leakage: Host vs container clock drift, TSC access

surfaces.name: Audit & detection matrix
surfaces.leakage: Cross-reference of detection methods for the above surfaces
surfaces.risk: Gaps in detection coverage map to blind spots
